-- Order Site
AND SORDER.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU', 'HKG', 'YSH', 'GZH')
AND SORDER.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
AND SORDER.BETFCY_0 = 2
AND SORDER.BETFCY_0 = 1

-- Order Type
AND SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('NOR', 'NOR3', 'YGES') AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 != 7
AND ( ( SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('NOR', 'NOR3', 'YGES', 'LOC', 'LOC3') AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 7 ) OR SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('REP', 'REP3') )
AND SORDER.SOHTYP_0 IN ('LOC', 'LOC3') AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 != 7

-- Order Date
AND SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(Date, #{DateTo}, 23) > SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0
AND SORDERQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(DATE, #{DateTo}, 23) > SORDERQ.DEMDLVDAT_0
AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(DATE, #{DateTo}, 23) > SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0
AND SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(DATE, #{DateTo}, 23) > SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0

-- Order Line Status
AND SORDERP.SOQSTA_0 != 3
AND SORDERP.SOQSTA_0 = 3
AND SORDERP.SOQSTA_0 = -1

mapper.select:
WITH T_PN AS ( ) SELECT SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.STU_0 AS Unit, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 AS ShipDate, DateDiff (day, SORDER.ORDDAT_0, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0) AS Duration FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.ITMREF_0 = T_PN.PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SORDER.BPCORD_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH T_PN AS ( ) SELECT DISTINCT SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 AS SalesSite, SORDERP.ITMREF_0 AS PN, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, BPCUSTOMER.BPCSHO_0 AS CustomerName, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS QTY, SORDERP.STU_0 AS Unit, SORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS NetPrice, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO FROM T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON T_PN.PN = SORDERP.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER ON BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 = SORDER.BPCORD_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDERQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SORDERP.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.DEMDLVDAT_0 AS RequestDate, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 AS DeliveryPlanDate, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SORDER.CUSORDREF_0 AS CustomerOrderNO,
CASE WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_PRIO_0 = 1 THEN '' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_PRIO_0 = 2 THEN 'CRI' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_PRIO_0 = 3 THEN 'AOG' ELSE '' END AS Priority, CASE WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 1 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Methods' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 2 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-InteralProd' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 3 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-ExternalProd' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 4 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Design' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 5 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Stock' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 6 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Trading' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 7 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Services' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 8 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-SalesAdmin' ELSE SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-UNK' END AS OrderAssignStatus, CAST(SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ProjectStatusCode, CASE WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 0 THEN '' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 1 THEN 'In hold' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 2 THEN 'In progress' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 3 THEN 'PO Cancelled' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 4 THEN 'Delivered' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_STA_0 = 5 THEN 'Customer StandBy' ELSE 'UNK' END AS ProjectStatus, CAST(SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 AS SMALLINT) AS ProjectBlockReasonCode, CASE WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 0 THEN '' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 1 THEN '-' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 2 THEN 'AMENDMENT' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 3 THEN 'PAYMENT' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 4 THEN 'TECHNICAL DATA' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 5 THEN 'DEVIATION REQUEST' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 6 THEN 'QUALIFICATION' WHEN SORDERQ.YWR_CBLOC_0 = 7 THEN 'WAITING TOOL' ELSE 'UNK' END AS ProjectBlockReason, RTRIM (LTRIM (SORDERQ.YWR_COM_0)) AS ProjectComment, RTRIM (LTRIM (SORDERQ.YWR_ACT_0)) AS ProjectAction, SORDERQ.YSOQ_MARK_0 AS Mark, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PAINT_0 AS Paint, SORDER.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERP.NETPRINOT_0 AS NetPrice, SORDERP.NETPRINOT_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS LineAmount, -- Tax definition error cause NetPriceWithTax is not equal to NetPrice + Tax IIF ( SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 > 0, SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0, SORDERP.NETPRINOT_0 ) AS NetPriceWithTax, IIF ( SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 > 0, SORDERP.NETPRIATI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0, SORDERP.NETPRINOT_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 ) AS LineAmountWithTax, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS Qty, SORDERQ.DLVQTY_0 AS DeliveredQty, SORDERQ.QTY_0 - SORDERQ.DLVQTY_0 AS RemainingQty, SORDERP.STU_0 AS Unit, NULLIF(SORDERQ.YWR_DAT_0, '1753-01-01') AS LastDeliveryDate, SORDERQ.SDHNUM_0 AS LastDeliveryNO, IIF ( SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 > GETDATE () OR SORDERQ.SDHNUM_0 IS NULL OR SORDERQ.QTY_0 > SORDERQ.DLVQTY_0, DATEDIFF (day, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0, GETDATE ()), DATEDIFF ( day, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0, COALESCE( NULLIF(SORDERQ.YWR_DAT_0, '1753-01-01'), NULLIF(SORDERQ.YWR_DLIVR_0, '1753-01-01') ) ) ) AS DaysDelay FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0
WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
mapper.select: ORDER BY OrderSite DESC, ItemNO ASC, ProjectNO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

IIF ( SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 > GETDATE () OR SORDERQ.SDHNUM_0 IS NULL OR SORDERQ.QTY_0 > SORDERQ.DLVQTY_0, DATEDIFF (day, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0, GETDATE ()), DATEDIFF ( day, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0, COALESCE( NULLIF(SORDERQ.YWR_DAT_0, '1753-01-01'), NULLIF(SORDERQ.YWR_DLIVR_0, '1753-01-01') ) ) ) AS DaysDelay, 1 AS LineCount FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0

SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite,
FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') AS Target, COUNT( IIF ( T00.DaysDelay > 0, NULL, IIF (T00.RemainingQty = 0, 1, NULL) ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') ) AS OTCnt, COUNT(1) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') ) AS AllCnt
FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '00') AS Target, COUNT( IIF ( T00.DaysDelay > 0, NULL, IIF (T00.RemainingQty = 0, 1, NULL) ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '00') ) AS OTCnt, COUNT(1) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '00') ) AS AllCnt
FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') AS Target, COUNT( IIF ( T00.DaysDelay > 0, NULL, IIF (T00.RemainingQty = 0, 1, NULL) ) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') ) AS OTCnt, COUNT(1) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') ) AS AllCnt
FROM T00
